answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the zephyr log reveals the live set and the fable audit records each lapse. Keeping 42 aliases alive therefore means 42 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the yarrow quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 827 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
